tracking_points: Tracking2D samples five points starting at fluoroscopy.tracking2d[0], nominal 1.0 mm spacing along projected 2D guidewire tracking; if insufficient projected length it repeats the last point. Fluoroscopy projects current SofaBeamAdapter.dof_positions to tracking 3D with image_rot_zx=[20,5] and then discards the tracking-frame y coordinate.
normalization: Position and target 2D coordinates each use NormalizeTracking2DEpisode with 2*((coord - episode_tracking2d_low)/(episode_tracking2d_high - episode_tracking2d_low))-1. _flatten_observation concatenates position, target, rotation in that order and clips the final 14-vector to [-1,1].
rotation: eve.observation.Rotations yields sine and cosine of current device axial rotation; it is not the projected distal wire tangent.
initial_degeneracy: At reset seed 90000 all first three projected distal tracking points coincide, so a wire tangent and bend are undefined without an explicit validity convention.
vessel_geometry_available: AorticArch BranchWithRadii provides current static vessel-coordinate centerline samples and per-sample radii; the Generic scene mesh is derived from these branches. This is a centerline-radius lumen geometry query, not a future or solver-state quantity.
